messages:
amy: Kicking off POC with Seabird. They want streaming SDK, tool-calls, and structured JSON output. Can someone advise quick POC auth (ephemeral vs API key) and if callbacks work through a sidecar?

raj: For a short POC use ephemeral tokens (30m TTL). Easier for rotation and shows good security posture. We can enable token service for their trial org. Example exchange: `POST /auth/token` with client creds -> ttl=1800.

amy: @raj how fast to enable?

raj: 15-20m to flip for an org and add sample script.

tom: Streaming + func-calls: use the JS or Go SDK. For sidecar callbacks, recommend running a tiny proxy in their VPC that accepts callbacks and forwards to their internal webhook. Livehook proxy works if they can open an outbound to our endpoint.

amy: Any enterprise blockers (SOC2, data residency, IP allowlist)?

tom: We have SOC2 and can share the report under NDA. IP allowlist available on Dedicated/Private. If they need on-prem, thats a longer sales cycle (legal + infra).

presales-bot: ACTIONS updated: created repo sample (stream+funcall), enabled trial org token service, assigned @tom for sidecar guide, assigned @raj for ephemeral creds.

amy: Schedule demo Tuesday 9am PT. Can tom and raj make it?

raj: Yup.

tom: In. Ill prep the sidecar diagram and a tiny livehook tester.

amy: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
